Forward algorithm (internal HMM helper)

Source: R/hidden_markov_model.R
forward_prob.Rd

Exposed for advanced use (e.g. custom pathway decompositions); most users will not call this directly.

Usage

forward_prob(
  obs,
  times,
  delta,
  rate_matrix,
  emission_matrix,
  return_state = FALSE,
  start_time = NULL
)

Arguments

obs

Observation sequence.

times

Observation times.

delta

Initial state distribution.

rate_matrix

Natural-history transition rate matrix.

emission_matrix

Emission probability matrix.

return_state

Logical; if TRUE, return the state-probability vector.

start_time

Optional start time for the recursion.

Value

The forward probability (or state vector if return_state = TRUE).
